notes: No accepted C++ submission (the recorded one is a WA brute that only answers n <= 20). orig.cpp was written for the corpus: E' is the edge set of a connected set of blocks, so it roots the block-cut tree at its centroid and, for each least component size s, multiplies the choices at the O(n / s) vertices surely in V'. It matches a brute over every nonempty edge subset on 300 generated cases with m <= 15.
